params.name: Send to Line: target line info
params.tooltip:
On: while you send vehicles to another line with Send to
Line, hovering a line on the map also shows its vehicles by
model and its capacity, utilization, frequency and rate.
Off: the game's hover text only.

params.name: Send to Line: before/after estimate
params.tooltip:
On: with "Send to Line: target line info" also On, the hover
text shows the line's capacity, frequency and rate as they
would be after sending the selected vehicles, marked ~ (an
estimate that assumes vehicles of similar speed). Off:
current values only.

params.name: Line editor: Undo and Redo buttons
params.tooltip:
On: Undo and Redo buttons left of Auto-Rename for the
selected line. Undo takes back your last stop edit,
Shift+click reverts every edit since you opened the line,
Redo brings an undone edit back. Off: no buttons.

params.name: Line list: line info on hover
params.tooltip:
On: in the Line Manager's line list, hovering a line shows a
panel next to the Line Manager with the line's vehicles by
model and its capacity, utilization, frequency and rate.
Off: the game's list only.

params.name: Send to Line list: line info panel
params.tooltip:
On: in the list that the Send to Line button opens, hovering
a line shows a panel right of the list with the line's
vehicles by model and its capacity, utilization, frequency
and rate; with "Send to Line: before/after estimate" also
On, it adds the values after sending, marked ~. Off: the
game's list only.

params.name: Line editor: Line actions button
params.tooltip:
On: a Line actions button right of Auto-Rename for the
selected line. Duplicate line makes a new line with the same
stops and settings, a new color and no vehicles. Reverse
line serves the stops in the opposite order, stop 1 staying
first (Undo takes it back). Off: no button.

params.name: Line actions: Match line rate
params.tooltip:
On: Match line rate in the Line actions menu opens a window
that compares the line's Rate with the supply it serves,
suggests how many vehicles to add or remove and which model
costs least, and on Apply buys, sells or replaces vehicles.
Needs "Line editor: Line actions button" On. Off: no entry.

params.name: Map: Shift-click a line opens the Line Manager
params.tooltip:
On: Shift-click one of your lines on the map to open the
Line Manager on it. With a line window open, Shift-click
empty ground or water to manage that line. Works on the
plain map and with entity windows open. Off: Shift-click
does what a click does.

params.name: Map: line info on hover
params.tooltip:
On: with the Line Manager open, hovering one of your lines
on the map also shows its vehicles by model and its
capacity, utilization, frequency and rate, below the game's
hover text. Off: the game's hover text only.

params.name: Vehicle list: current cargo
params.tooltip:
On: each vehicle in the Line Manager's vehicle list shows
what it carries right now, between its name and its picture:
the cargo's icon and load, e.g. 6/25, dimmed when empty.
Off: the game's list only.

params.name: Vehicle list: vehicle info on hover
params.tooltip:
On: in the Line Manager's vehicle list, hovering a vehicle's
picture shows a panel next to the Line Manager with the
vehicle's line, its parts (every locomotive and wagon of a
train), top speed, power, weight, age, condition, running
costs, value and last year's balance. Off: the game's list
only.

params.name: Buy Vehicles: filter by the line's cargo
params.tooltip:
On: Buy Vehicles for a selected line opens the vehicle store
with the line's cargo already ticked in its cargo filter
(passengers for a bus line), when the line carries one cargo
type. Replace and Modify for vehicles of one line do the same.
Off: the store opens unfiltered.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Line Manager Plus writes
how long its additions to the Line Manager took to the
game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]),
plus a line per recorded edit. Only for tracking down
slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls are always
logged briefly, whatever this setting.
